items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Happy Bolton was on drums with Joe Oliver... [INTERVIEWEE] Might have been.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, I know that's where we played too, you said, do I remember. I don't remember, I remember playing it.
I think Happy Bolton was on drums with Joe Oliver. Jim, that might have been after your time.
